facts.text: The product is the Tatva Natural Latex and Coir Mattress, combining natural latex and coir.
Selected variant: Queen, 72 x 60 in (183 x 152 cm), 6 in (15.2 cm) high.
The product specification lists a firm mattress feel for the Queen size.
A biodegradable latex layer with a pin-core structure is enhanced by high-density coir for firm structural support.
The latex layer is described as naturally resilient and supportive, and forms the mattress core.
The Queen-size specification lists a tight-top style.
The product description identifies coir as naturally cooling.
